people.name: Cornelius
people.line: Centurion, first Gentile convert to Christianity

translations.web: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.
translations.bsb: When the angel who spoke to him had gone, Cornelius called two of his servants and a devout soldier from among his attendants.
translations.kjv: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;
translations.asv: And when the angel that spake unto him was departed, he called two of his household-servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;
